'''Ali Reza Ashrafi ''' (10 May 1964 – 9 January 2023) was an Iranian mathematician who worked in [[computational group theory]] and [[mathematical chemistry]]. Ashrafi was a professor at the department of pure mathematics of the [[University of Kashan]]<ref>{{GoogleScholar|id=hqM116QAAAAJ}}</ref> and the vice president of the [[International Academy of Mathematical Chemistry]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://kashanu.ac.ir/fa/news/6950|accessdate=10 January 2023|title=عضو هیات علمی دانشگاه کاشان معاون اول آکادمی جهانی ریاضی شیمی شد|website=University of Kashan|date=31 December 2017}}</ref> 

He received his PhD in 1995 from the [[University of Tehran]], with thesis ''Irreducible character table of the group'' <math>\operatorname{Aut}(\operatorname{SL}_5(3))</math> written under the direction of [[Mohammad Reza Darafsheh]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=116635}}</ref>

==Death==
Ashrafi died in a car accident on the way home in [[Kashan]] on 9 January 2023.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://kashanu.ac.ir/fa/news/21204/|access-date=2 July 2018 |title=دکتر اشرفی عضو هیات علمی دانشگاه کاشان دار فانی را وداع گفت|website=University of Kashan]| date=9 January 2023}}</ref>
